cases.question: 请同时列出2026年8月青禾优选的注册会员数、观测期首购会员数、观测期首单净销售额（单位分）、观测期首单数、观测期后续购买订单数和有效订单数。

actual.sql:
SELECT
  MAX(subq_12.new_member_count) AS new_member_count
  , MAX(subq_19.first_buyer_count) AS first_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_19.first_order_sales_cents) AS first_order_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_19.first_order_count) AS first_order_count
  , MAX(subq_19.repeat_order_count) AS repeat_order_count
  , MAX(subq_26.valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(1) AS new_member_count
  FROM "data"."main"."members" members_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', registered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_12
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN valid_order_seq = 1 THEN member_id END) AS first_buyer_count
    , SUM(CASE WHEN valid_order_seq = 1 THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS first_order_sales_cents
    , SUM(CASE WHEN valid_order_seq = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_order_count
    , SUM(CASE WHEN valid_order_seq >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."order_sequence" order_sequence_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_19
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_26

actual.sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(subq_12.member, subq_20.member) AS member
  , MAX(subq_12.first_buyer_count) AS first_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_12.first_order_sales_cents) AS first_order_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_12.first_order_count) AS first_order_count
  , MAX(subq_12.repeat_order_count) AS repeat_order_count
  , MAX(subq_20.valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    member
    , COUNT(DISTINCT first_buyer_count) AS first_buyer_count
    , SUM(first_order_sales_cents) AS first_order_sales_cents
    , SUM(first_order_count) AS first_order_count
    , SUM(repeat_order_count) AS repeat_order_count
  FROM (
    SELECT
      member_id AS member
      , CASE WHEN valid_order_seq = 1 THEN member_id END AS first_buyer_count
      , CASE WHEN valid_order_seq = 1 THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS first_order_sales_cents
      , CASE WHEN valid_order_seq = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS first_order_count
      , CASE WHEN valid_order_seq >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repeat_order_count
    FROM "data"."main"."order_sequence" order_sequence_src_10000
    WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  ) subq_8
  WHERE member in ('M00005','M00007')
  GROUP BY
    member
) subq_12
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    member
    , SUM(valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
  FROM (
    SELECT
      member_id AS member
      , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS valid_order_count
    FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
    WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  ) subq_16
  WHERE member in ('M00005','M00007')
  GROUP BY
    member
) subq_20
ON
  subq_12.member = subq_20.member
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(subq_12.member, subq_20.member)

actual.sql:
WITH sma_10002_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', month_start) AS metric_time__day
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __monthly_buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."monthly_member_fact" monthly_member_fact_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_8.monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_15.monthly_repeat_rate) AS monthly_repeat_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(__monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10002_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_8
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    CAST(SUM(__monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(__monthly_buyer_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS monthly_repeat_rate
  FROM sma_10002_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_15

actual.sql:
WITH sma_10002_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', month_start) AS metric_time__day
    , DATE_TRUNC('month', month_start) AS metric_time__month
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __monthly_buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."monthly_member_fact" monthly_member_fact_src_10000
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(subq_8.metric_time__month, subq_14.metric_time__month) AS metric_time__month
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(CAST(subq_14.monthly_repeat_buyer_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_14.monthly_buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS monthly_repeat_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , SUM(__monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10002_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_8
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , SUM(__monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10002_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_14
ON
  subq_8.metric_time__month = subq_14.metric_time__month
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(subq_8.metric_time__month, subq_14.metric_time__month)

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id END) AS buyer_count
  , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id END) AS refund_buyer_count

actual.sql:
SELECT
  store
  , CAST(net_sales_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(valid_order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_order_value
  , CAST(net_sales_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_buyer_value
  , CAST(valid_order_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS purchase_frequency
  , CAST(refund_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(payment_cents, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_amount_rate
  , CAST(cancelled_order_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS cancel_rate
  , CAST(refund_order_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(paid_order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_order_rate
  , CAST(discount_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(gross_cents, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS discount_rate
  , CAST(valid_order_items AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(valid_order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS items_per_order
FROM (
  SELECT
    store
    , SUM(__net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
    , SUM(__valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __buyer_count) AS buyer_count
    , SUM(__refund_cents) AS refund_cents
    , SUM(__payment_cents) AS payment_cents
    , SUM(__cancelled_order_count) AS cancelled_order_count
    , SUM(__order_count) AS order_count
    , SUM(__refund_order_count) AS refund_order_count
    , SUM(__paid_order_count) AS paid_order_count
    , SUM(__discount_cents) AS discount_cents
    , SUM(__gross_cents) AS gross_cents
    , SUM(__valid_order_items) AS valid_order_items
  FROM (
    SELECT
      store_id AS store
      , 1 AS __order_count
      , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __paid_order_count
      , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __valid_order_count
      , CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __cancelled_order_count
      , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __refund_order_count
      , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents ELSE 0 END AS __payment_cents
      , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __refund_cents
      , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __net_sales_cents
      , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents ELSE 0 END AS __gross_cents
      , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents - paid_cents ELSE 0 END AS __discount_cents

  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents - paid_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS discount_rate

actual.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(net_sales_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(valid_order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_order_value
  , CAST(SUM(net_sales_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT buyer_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_buyer_value
  , CAST(SUM(valid_order_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT buyer_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS purchase_frequency
  , CAST(SUM(refund_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(payment_cents), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_amount_rate
  , CAST(SUM(cancelled_order_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS cancel_rate
  , CAST(SUM(refund_order_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(paid_order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_order_rate
  , CAST(SUM(discount_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(gross_cents), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS discount_rate
  , CAST(SUM(valid_order_items) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(valid_order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS items_per_order
FROM (
  SELECT
    channel AS order__channel
    , 1 AS order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS paid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS valid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cancelled_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS refund_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents ELSE 0 END AS payment_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS refund_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS net_sales_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents ELSE 0 END AS gross_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents - paid_cents ELSE 0 END AS discount_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id END AS buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END AS valid_order_items
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_15
WHERE order__channel in ('小程序')
actual.answer: 统计范围：青禾客户，2026年8月（按2026-08-01至2026-09-01左闭右开覆盖整月），渠道为小程序；数据为合成测试库，本次结果未按门店等维度分组。口径与结果：有效订单均额为37.46元/单；购买会员人均消费为37.46元/账户；购买频次为1.00单/账户；退款金额占比为22.33%；取消率为6.25%；退款订单率为13.33%；优惠率为4.71%；单均商品件数为1.15件/单。金额已由分换算为元并保留两位小数，比例已换算为百分数并适当四舍五入。限制：以上均为该客户、该月份、该渠道范围内的汇总值，不能据此推断其他渠道、其他月份或门店分组；购买会员按CRM会员账户计数，不等同于跨系统自然人已去重。
